notes.title: Castle of Secrets Update #2
notes.content:
Hello Curse Breakers,

We have prepared another patch to address bugs, increase character movement speed, improve cutscenes, and also add a new hidden location!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41822167/510697784590f28d28caac3b68de156b153a7d0f.png[/img]
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Find the secret passage to the hidden location of the ruined city through the Hell level and unlock an achievement.
[*] A new scene with two wooden monsters has been added to the Graveyard location.
[*] Bug fixes.
[*] Increased character movement speed.
[*] Quest titles no longer overflow the task frame.
[*] Added sounds to cutscenes for better immersion.
[*] Hints on the F key are now always visible, even from a distance.
[*] Fixed some achievement issues.
[*] Added music to the skeleton disco — now they dance to the beat!
[/list]

notes.title: Castle of Secrets Update #1
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has checked out the game since launch! We are keeping an eye on feedback and have put together an update to address some initial issues:

[b][h2]Patch Highlights[/h2][/b][list]
[*] Fixed various bugs
[*] Added particle effects to hard-to-find items
[*] Improved localization
[*] Increased the number of interactive objects
[*] Removed unnecessary objects from scenes that were getting in the way
[*] Added a new cutscene for the tree monster
[*] Adjusted sound volumes to prevent sudden loud noises
[/list]
